note: flat_art.py recolour / cut (DECISIONS.md D172): painted frames whose colours drifted from the sprite's, recoloured with the sprite's own palette ramp (histogram-matched brightness, the sprite's colour at each brightness). layout: how much of the brightness order is the sprite's own (0 the painting's, 1 a smoothed sprite); size 2 objects are fitted whole and frames lists their first tiles; tiles names a flat_art.py LAYOUTS arrangement for an object drawn as other sprites than blit_sprite2x2's (D214). joins: beams stacked edge to edge (the Zica Laser's head, body and tail; the enemy beam #7 286-288, D221), whose edges continue into the next piece. hue "art": only the brightness is matched, the painting keeping its own hue (a grey rock with a coloured vent or crystal); ink: the sprite's dark outline ring is left out of the target ramp (the asteroids, cut with art_alpha).
